Results.ReviewText: Have used the string trimmer, brush cutter, and the pole saw so far.  Have not used the hedge trimmer yet. Trimmer is easy to load with strings and bump feeds well. Have not tried the harness yet but that may help with keeping my arm away from the heat. I have only used the canned 50:1 fuel so far. It cranks every time and has yet to stall. It's loud, a little clunky and heavy overall and not very practical for edging but they do offer an edging attachment. I was skeptical about the quality and purchased the $29.99 protection plan.  The plan offers 50% reimbursement for things needed to keep this tool running.  The plan will pay for itself if you are diligent about saving receipts and submitting them correctly. So far I bought 2 cans of fuel, bar oil, and string. Really wanted to go electric but after research, decided gas was the only way for this kind of tool.

Results.ReviewText: I have used this product twice so far and i love it. Its so easy and quick to switch heads! I can take my weed eater head off and put on the bladed headed within a minute! Runs like a champ with non ethanol 2 in 1 gas mixture! I cant wait to try out the hedge trimmer and chainsaw heads next! One little thing about it is that this is a bigger weed eater so it has a little weight to it but that is expected, but it does come with a chest harness that is extremely padded and comfortable to help with the weight.
Results.Title: Great product! You wont be disappointed!
